description: Dependency-free C++ validator (x64 static library, MSVC) for JBOpale.LicenceManager licence keys: ECDSA P-256 verification through Windows CNG, machine code, custom fields. Validation only, no private key.

Compact, offline software licence keys signed with ECDSA P-256: issue and validate keys in .NET, with optional machine binding and custom fields. Keys are also readable by the dependency-free C++ validator (JBOpale.LicenceManager.Cpp).
Lumina-themed chart controls for Avalonia and LuminaUI.
